action_items: No functional fixes required. All testable requirements from the review request are satisfied.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/brand/dk-swap.js is 1381 lines – still a single file. The new NullCash additions (ensureMore, showTour, ensureDock/openSheet, ensurePitch/openOnb, ensureWalletBtn) are concatenated into it. Would recommend splitting into modules (nc-nav.js, nc-tour.js, nc-dock.js, nc-pitch.js, nc-connect.js) for maintainability.

test_bifrost.py and test_iter12_security.py fail at collection when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not in the test runner env – they assert BASE_URL at import time. Consider lazy-loading via conftest fixture or sourcing frontend/.env automatically so pytest works without manual env export.

null-prefix mapping (nullsk2/nullvk1/null2) is applied via text replacement in backend/bifrost.py null_prefix_js(). This is working across recovery key, Receive address, and clipboard output; no 'veil' tokens leaked in any rendered path we touched. Good.
Live stats polling on landing/app still 429s intermittently on upstream referrals/icons (same as iter 12). Not a regression; a frontend-side backoff would reduce console noise.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all requested checks (desktop tabs, More menu, tour, pitch, connect box, wallet create flow, nullsk2/null2 prefixes, clipboard, mobile dock/menu, landing nav + launch).
